_note: Menu audit of 2026-09-27, after the owner asked whether the header and mobile menus cover every category. Every product was already reachable from a second-level menu category except one (the Red Bull Salzburg shirt, league:austrian-bundesliga). Changes made in the store (they are shared by every theme, so they are live): the football sub-menu order, so that on a 1440x900 screen the first two rows of the mega panel show the eight main categories (national teams and the Israeli league were in a third row below the fold); a collection image for 12 menu tiles (distinct adult shirts from each category, instead of the first product: two tiles showed the same Tottenham shirt, four showed kids sets, and the special-editions tile showed a football shirt with a religious print); other-leagues also takes league:austrian-bundesliga; special-editions is basketball only (it sits under basketball in the menu; its 8 football shirts stay in their team and league collections). Menu items kept their IDs, so their English and Arabic translations are unchanged (read back: outdated false). To undo the order, run menuUpdate with the before order and the same item IDs. Collection images were null before; the rules before are listed below.

other-leagues.before: TAG league:saudi-pro-league OR TAG league:mls OR TAG league:liga-mx OR TAG league:brasileirao (17 products)

special-editions.after: TAG style:special AND TAG sport:basketball (57 products)
